items.excerpt: Producer John Dahlback, once skeptical of AI, explains how he now folds AI tools — especially vocal processing — into his production workflow, treating them as a creative instrument rather than a shortcut.

AI song generators like Suno don't confer copyright ownership because their product design spits out a finished track from a single prompt without capturing the human creative decisions courts require to establish authorship.

The RIAA and IFPI are leading an industry proposal for streaming platforms to label tracks with two tags — 'AI-generated' for fully AI-made songs and 'AI-assisted' for human-led works with some AI involvement.

An op-ed argues Spotify is policing fraudulent AI uploads while simultaneously monetizing AI music through its new UMG-partnered paid feature that lets Premium users generate covers and remixes of licensed songs.

BBC music boss Lorna Clarke outlined the broadcaster's AI transparency commitments — including disclosing when AI is used in its output — though the piece questions whether the BBC can actually meet them.
